documentation.content:
An alert's investigation failed. The case is marked *error* on the Live queue and will not be retried.

1. Open Agent Activity > Health to see which alerts and the error text.
2. Most common cause: TigerGraph unreachable (Savanna workspace suspended) or the client graph missing queries. Resume the workspace / run `python -m graph.setup_graph --only queries`.
3. Re-send the alert once fixed.

Console: {{CONSOLE_URL}} · Logs: Cloud Logging, filter `jsonPayload.event="investigation_error"` on services `{{SERVICE}}*`.
